content: {"episode_id":"ep-05038","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05038, which states that precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9), continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control. We request review of medical necessity and reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 703.89."}
